'''Grimtotem Post'''{{coords|74|85|Stonetalon Mountains}} is the base of [[Grimtotem]] operations in Stonetalon.  Many different types, such as Brutes, Ruffians, Sorcerers, and Mercenaries patrol the post and nearby areas. The Grimtotem here are lead by the fierce [[Grundig Darkcloud]].
